verdict.rationale: Skills are installed, invoked, and tested through Anthropic's official terminal tool, Claude Code. It supports `/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`, direct `/skill-name` invocation, and the `--plugin-dir` flag for local testing. However, all of this runs through the host agent's CLI rather than a dedicated skills tool. Missing for 10: a standalone first-party skills CLI (e.g., for scaffolding, validating, or uploading skills outside Claude Code), CLI-side management of the Skills API (upload is documented only via the API), and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI install/management workflow.
